asr.full_text: I've seen a bunch of stories within the past 6 months attempting to make Woke Goldman Sachs a thing And I wanted to share one of these with you This is from Fortune Magazine, listen to this In the era of President Donald Trump, Goldman Sachs CEO, Lloyd Blankfein Wants to make sure his company isn't misunderstood That's why the 62-year old executive took to Twitter for the very first time Following President Trump's decision to exit the Paris Climate Agreement earlier this month. According to a Monday interview Blankfein gave to Jim Cramer on CNBC's Mad Money. Following Trump's announcement, Blankfein took to Twitter to say that Trump's decision is a setback for the environment and for the U.S. leadership's position in the world. Since then, the CEO has tweeted every few days about infrastructure, former GE CEO, Geoff Imelt's retirement and immigration. The CEO has has had the account since 2011, and had been under pressure to tweet from the handle for some time, according to Politico What? Anybody knows the fuck about this guy? Blankfein said he chose the Paris Agreement For his Twitter Debut In order to avoid a mistake Goldman Sachs major in the financial crisis Quote In the financial crisis Nobody knew what Goldman Sachs did The value we create What we do in the communities Blankfein told Kramer And I said if this ever happens again, I'm not going to allow there to be a vacuum about what we're like. We're gonna have to communicate to the world what we do. Has there ever been a group of sleezier, slimier scumbags than at Goldman Sachs? Because it's not just that they have to fuck everybody over, rig the system in favor of themselves, get rich at everybody else's expense Do fraud in the process That's what they did during the subprime mortgage crisis and the great recession But as they do that Now the CEO goes out there and PRETENDS And pulls the wool over your eyes and tries to make you believe Well what do you mean we got The work nobody knew the work we do in the communities. And I'm not going to let there be a vacuum where people could fill it in with what Goldman actually does. I'm going to get out there and do propaganda to get in front of this and to make everybody think we're good, even though we're not. They want you to believe that Goldman-Sachs cares about quote the communities. What the fuck are you- that's not even what you're geared towards. You're a profit-making entity, that's what you are! Stop trying to pretend like, oh yeah, we care, we care about the people! I almost have, you know, more respect for other rapacious corporations like McDonald's or something, because they're not pretending. They're like, yeah, no, we just want your money and we're gonna serve you some shitty food, I mean, you know what he's trying to do And this is one of the problems with Trump is that Trump has now made it so that in polite society Anything but Trump is viewed as acceptable So that means you could be fucking Paul Ryan. You can be Evan McMuffin. You could be these other Loadsome jackasses with horrible positions that screw over the American people, but since you're not Trump, get moderate. You're moderate. You're not bad. You're not Trump. And now Goldman Sachs is trying to cash in on that. Say, well, yeah, no, I mean sure you guys might not like us, but Trump, the thing he did with the Paris Agreement, ah, tsk-tsk, see, we're against that too, regular people. Don't you think we're great? No, we fucking don't! And by the way, the new trick of corporate America, not really all that new, but it just seems to be more brazen recently, is they just lie. They'll just lie. So he's acting like, yeah, we don't like Donald. Really? Then why are four Goldman Sachs officials in top positions in his administration? And why are you tweeting about infrastructure? Does Goldman Sachs all of a sudden care about, oh, we just want to upgrade American infrastructure? Wouldn't it be great if we caught up to the rest of the modern world? No, you wanna know why he's doing it? Because Trump's plan is a privatization scheme that turns over a lot of US infrastructure to... Goldman Sachs. Go fuck yourself. Go fuck yourself, Lloyd Blankfein. You're a joke. You're a shitty person. You're a greedy motherfucker and we're sick of it. We're sick of you, we're sick of Goldman Sachs, woke Goldman Sachs isn't a thing, And money should be out of politics, so you assholes can't buy the government like you've already sufficiently done.
